description: V4-exact relational transformer with ellipse shape-tensor tokens (improve of r00_draft2_v4tf; ONE change: the resonator token features). 1 global token embedded from (h, p) and 4 resonator tokens embedded by ONE shared GELU MLP from features that depend only on the physical ellipse: s = rx+ry, u = (rx-ry)cos 2theta, v = (rx-ry)sin 2theta (shape tensor M = R diag(rx, ry) R^T = [[s+u, v], [v, s-u]] / 2), |d| = sqrt(u^2+v^2+eps^2), u/|d|, v/|d|, plus h, p; so (rx, ry, theta) and (ry, rx, theta -+ pi/2), e.g. the two encodings of every ellipse at theta = +-pi/4, give identical outputs. n_layers pr
model_repr:
V4RelTransformer(
  (res_embed): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=8, out_features=320, bias=True)
    (1): GELU(approximate='none')
    (2): Linear(in_features=320, out_features=320, bias=True)
  )
  (glob_embed): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=2, out_features=320, bias=True)
    (1): GELU(approximate='none')
    (2): Linear(in_features=320, out_features=320, bias=True)
  )
  (blocks): ModuleList(
    (0-3): 4 x Block(
      (n1): LayerNorm((320,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
      (att): RelAttention(
        (qkv): Linear(in_features=320, out_features=960, bias=True)
        (proj): Linear(in_features=320, out_features=320, bias=True)
      )
      (n2): LayerNorm((320,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
      (ff): Sequential(
        (0): Linear(in_features=320, out_features=1280, bias=True)
        (1): GELU(approximate='none')
        (2): Linear(in_features=1280, out_features=320, bias=True)
      )
      (drop): Dropout(p=0.02, inplace=False)
    )
  )
  (norm): LayerNorm((320,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
  (head): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=640, out_features=1536, bias=True)
    (1): GELU(approximate='none')
    (2): Dropout(p=0.02, inplace=False)
    (3): Linear(in_features=1536, out_features=1536, bias=True)
    (4): GELU(approximate='none')
    (5): Dropout(p=0.02, inplace=False)
    (6): Linear(in_features=1536, out_features=2001, bias=True)
  )
)
